`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

`tax_for` was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no earlier rounding to change. I wrote it from scratch: it multiplies `amount_cents` by the rate as a `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It returns an `int`. Nothing in the repo calls `tax_for` yet, so I assumed `rate` is a fraction such as `0.0825`. Say so if it's a percentage or comes in another form.

I also updated the EngramDB memory "Tax uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN". It now says half-up, dated 2026-10-01, and notes it replaces the March 2026 banker's-rounding decision. The memory file under `.engramdb/memories/` is tracked in git, so it shows up as a change.
